descripcion: Imagination generators. comfyui: url = ComfyUI base URL; workflow = API-format txt2img graph (path relative to the project root; nodes are found by role through links); checkpoint = ckpt_name for CheckpointLoaderSimple (null keeps the workflow value); timeout_seconds = how long to wait for the finished image before failing. Keys left out keep the defaults in core/adapters/comfyui_image_generator.py.
